SG-RAG leverages Cypher queries to search the given knowledge graph and retrieve the necessary subgraph to answer the question. The results from our previous work showed a higher performance of our method compared to the traditional Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). In this work, we further enhance SG-RAG by proposing an additional step called Merging and Ordering Triplets (MOT). The new MOT step seeks to decrease the redundancy in the retrieved triplets by applying hierarchical merging on the retrieved subgraphs.
